primary: All 2-second-grid windows with 1500 valid raw samples and official endpoint label. Do not exclude mixed or early windows from evaluation.
training_scope: 45 development records. Event timing only in offline labels/weights/diagnostics. First phase is not a known transition.
lr_joint_rule: Choose T_task and T_relax separately among 0/6/15/30 by three-fold inner full-validation score; then evaluate 14 predeclared joint/weight/soft candidates on the same inner folds. No outer metrics affect this process.

neural.scheduler: ReduceLROnPlateau factor0.5 patience8 min_lr1e-5; hard validation BCE, inner records only
neural.original_control: legacy6 and long150_pure retain pure training windows, original global pos_weight and constant LR. Only training duration / inner checkpoint selection differs.
neural.other_control: long150_full versus scheduled150_full isolates scheduler; use identical global pos_weight and train rows. transition/curriculum add record-class-balanced supervision, disclosed as a strategy bundle.
neural.epoch_selection: One fixed whole-record inner validation split (one third of outer-training records), all valid labeled windows retained. Select best record composite; early stop on no score improvement. Refit outer training for selected epoch with fixed LR schedule replay, never monitor outer validation.
neural.curriculum: stable first 15 epochs (T_task=T_relax=30), linear introduction epochs16-30, full supervision thereafter; best epoch and early stopping eligible only from epoch31.
neural.checkpoint: Save best and last per epoch, optimizer/scheduler/RNG, training and validation loss and full record bACC/AUC. Save epoch6 snapshot for long-run control.

evaluation: All fixed ablations reported on identical outer records. LR selected procedure has record/date nested validation. Neural conditions use record outer folds and internal epoch tuning; no date-generalization claim for neural models without subsequent date tests.
promotion: Record paired-bootstrap composite gain lower 95% bound >0; all 3 record outer-fold gains >0; date macro composite and record macro bACC nondecreasing.
neural_promotion: Must first pass record bootstrap, all record folds and bACC gate against fixed LR; only then run nested date confirmation and full-package verification. Otherwise research only.
diagnostics: Baseline cross-fitted predictions; bins 0/2/4/6/10/15/20/30/60/inf, initial phases separate, pure/mixed separate; trial then record averaging; paired record bootstrap for directional early-versus-stable differences. No individual physiological transition time forced.
future: No transition-aware inference or external event input. No paid resources. Preserve old archives.
limitations: Previously used development data; participant/electrode/device unavailable; no untouched independent evaluation.
